acas.name: Acas employment advice
acas.lastSummary: Provider guidance confirms the employment advice service, contact number, weekday hours, free advice with possible phone charges, and interpreter/BSL/relay access.

adhd-uk.name: ADHD UK
adhd-uk.lastSummary: The provider links to online support groups and free tickets with optional donations. Other marketplace services are separate. Detailed eligibility for individual groups was not independently checked.

advice.name: Citizens Advice Harrow
advice.lastSummary: The provider confirms free independent advice, the listed freephone number, weekday hours and web enquiry form. The precise residency rule was not repeated on this contact page.

brent-accessible-travel.name: Brent — accessible travel and transport
brent-accessible-travel.lastSummary: The council lists disability and older-person travel schemes, mobility support and community transport, with application routes and the matching Adult Social Care number. Individual scheme costs and criteria still need checking.

brent-active-together-finder.name: Brent Active Together — activity finder
brent-active-together-finder.lastSummary: The provider describes borough-wide community activity and links to its activity finder. The finder is embedded; individual session prices, availability and booking flows were not tested.

brent-adult-care.name: Brent Adult Social Care
brent-adult-care.lastSummary: The council confirms care, independence and carers support, care-cost guidance and the listed contact number. The online self-assessment route requires a separate check; no change is inferred from its absence on the landing page.

brent-advance.name: Advance — Brent domestic abuse support
brent-advance.lastSummary: The provider confirms the Brent service and contact number, practical safety and rights support, and a separate section supporting men. Confidentiality has stated safeguarding exceptions. No material mismatch was found in these checked fields.

brent-ageuk.name: Age UK Hillingdon, Harrow and Brent
brent-ageuk.lastSummary: The provider confirms support for older people across the named boroughs, free and paid services, and the listed contact number. Individual services retain their own age and locality requirements.
